title: Strata — high-performance, AI-safe self-service analytics
excerpt: High-performance, AI-safe self-service analytics — a governed semantic layer fused with beautiful-by-default dashboards, for humans and agents.
content_html:
The most capable Business Intelligence platform for the AI age

15 minutes from setup to insights. On your machine, with Docker and your own coding agent.

Enterprise reporting for Everyone

High-performance, AI-safe self-service analytics — one platform from warehouse to beautiful dashboard.

15 minutes from setup to insights. On your machine, with Docker and your own coding agent.

High performance AI turns on federated Open OLAP engines

Partition-aware routing to fast hot tiers and aggregate tables — sub-second answers, lower warehouse spend.

Born at Netflix, ready for the world

One platform, four propositions

A governed semantic layer, beautiful self-service dashboards, agents grounded in live data, and the open OLAP engines that make it all fast. One system, four ways to put it to work.

How we stack up

The only product that is both a governed semantic layer and a beautiful self-service tool. Compare it to whatever you use today.
